svg.title: LeadGen application entity relationship diagram
svg.desc: Fourteen PostgreSQL tables for users, workspaces, campaigns, candidates, evidence-backed qualification, leads, scoring, and review history.
svg.text: Team T0147 · PostgreSQL / Supabase · evidence-backed lead qualification · 14 tables

g.text: Application identity; credentials remain in Supabase Auth
One membership per user per workspace
Optional customer for whom a campaign runs
draft → queued → discovering → validating → scoring → completed
M:N bridge; candidate is not yet a lead
Normalized business identity; deduplicated before enrichment
Every surfaced fact retains source URL and observation time
fit · need · timing · reachability · evidence quality
PK primary key · FK foreign key · UK unique key · NULL optional
Arrow points from parent to child; labels show parent-to-child cardinality.
A candidate becomes a lead only after source-backed evidence and qualification.
Every campaign, client, and member is scoped through a workspace.

svg.text: Designed from LeadGen README.md and PRODUCT.md · planned MVP database model
